title: Apple Music and Spotify wiping out illegal music downloads in UK
text:
Search Apple Music and Spotify wiping out illegal music downloads in UK
The number of people illegally downloading music has dropped significantly as sophisticated online blocks make it harder for people to find free downloads. The lengths now needed for people to access free music has forced people to legitimate streaming services, like Apple Music, Spotify and Deezer. According to new figures from YouGov, just one in 10 Britons now get their music from an illegitimate source – down from 18 per cent five years earlier.
